g.text: GREAT LAKES INTER-TRIBAL COUNCIL • IHS BEMIDJI AREA
🌲 GICHIGAMI (LAKE SUPERIOR), WILD RICE MARSHES & BIRCHBARK WOODS

div.style: font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.45;

foreignObject.div: Where boundless, crystal waters of Gichigami lap against sandstone cliffs and pristine pebble shores. From autumn wild rice (Manoomin) harvesting in gentle canoes gliding through reeds, to the sweet fragrance of balsam fir and sacred sweetgrass (Wiingashk) under northern pine canopies, health is the Seven Grandfathers.
